arStrings.szText: The Sector's Finest Armor Collection Pack

This Mega Bundle includes "The Rebel Marshal" Barbarian equipment, "Heaven's Devil" Druid equipment, "Overqueen of the Swarm" Necromancer equipment, "The Dark Prelate" Rogue equipment, "The High Templar" Sorcerer equipment, and "The Quest of Blades" Spiritborn equipment.
